mapper.sql:
FROM ast_device_relationship r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND r.deleted=b'0' AND r.relationship_type='EXTRA_SN'
AND (CAST(r.source_device_sn AS BINARY)=CAST(#{query.deviceSn} AS BINARY) OR CAST(r.target_device_sn AS BINARY)=CAST(#{query.deviceSn} AS BINARY))
AND CAST(r.contract_no AS BINARY) IN CAST(#{contractNo} AS BINARY)
AND 1=0
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ast_device d WHERE d.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND d.deleted=b'0' AND (CAST(d.sn AS BINARY)=CAST(r.source_device_sn AS BINARY) OR CAST(d.sn AS BINARY)=CAST(r.target_device_sn AS BINARY)) AND (d.project_id=#{query.projectId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ast_device_project_relationship pr WHERE pr.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND pr.device_sn=d.sn AND pr.deleted=b'0' AND pr.project_id=#{query.projectId} AND pr.effective_from <=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (pr.effective_to IS NULL OR pr.effective_to>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) )) )
AND 1=0
mapper.select: SELECT r.* ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{query.offset},#{query.limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ast_device_relationship SET create_time=#{command.createTime},update_time=#{command.updateTime},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{command.tenantId} AND id=#{command.id} AND version=#{command.expectedVersion} AND deleted=b'0' AND source_system='DPPMS' AND relationship_type='EXTRA_SN'
